generator: Existing G8 selected-generator public answers only; withheld answers never declassified
isolation: Fresh ephemeral read-only Codex sessions, empty working directory; transcript must prove zero tool calls. Sandbox alone does not prevent reads. Any tool call invalidates isolation.

criteria.PASS: Traceable hypotheses and alternatives, actual additional retrieval, explicit reassessment, no boundary violation, sealed before comparison. Reasoned uncertainty is acceptable.
criteria.FAIL: Observed leak, unsupported valid answer, isolation violation or induced conclusion.
criteria.NOT READY: Required access or independent subject unavailable before investigation.
